def solution():
    # Define variables name and value
    equity_market_value = 150
    debt_market_value = 100
    cost_of_equity = 0.09
    cost_of_debt = 0.05
    tax_rate = 0.25

    # Do math calculation to get the answer
    total_value = equity_market_value + debt_market_value
    equity_weight = equity_market_value / total_value
    debt_weight = debt_market_value / total_value
